ademp.aims: Assess a test-only global max-rank procedure on the fixed development matrix.
ademp.data: 1300 paired datasets; four200-case nulls and two250-case alternatives,999 shared entity-label assignments per case.
ademp.estimands: Global distribution equality under entity-label exchangeability; not omnibus sensitivity or latent-component identification.
ademp.methods: {"candidate": "same-draw global maximum exact rank statistic", "fixedCv": "prespecified same-draw marginal coefficient-of-variation permutation test, strictp<.05", "fixedMedian": "prespecified same-draw marginal median permutation test, strictp<.05", "permutationBonferroni": "same999 draws, marginal permutation p-values with Bonferroni12", "shipped": "shipped raw rank p-values with Bonferroni12"}
ademp.performance: 1,300/1,300 cases completed. Primary heavy-tail null: global candidate 19/200, Wilson 95% [0.061663, 0.143602], versus shipped 7/200 and same-draw permutation Bonferroni 6/200. Candidate power 79/250 and 125/250 versus shipped 35/250 and 72/250. Null advancement inconclusive; no activation. Supporting Round28 independent arithmetic reconstruction matched all 200 original null cases and 199,800 assignments; it adds no scientific samples.
ademp.truth: Conditions0..3 are null;4..5 are location/dispersion alternatives; no holdout generated.

ademp.aims: Compare normal-tail numerical accuracy and policy decisions for one isolated return-expression substitution.
ademp.data: 3173 binary64 scalar inputs,8specials,165rank fixtures and365threshold-policy comparisons; deterministic grids, not sampled studies.
ademp.estimands: Normal two-sided tail probability and native decision-policy output; unchanged rank arithmetic.
ademp.methods: {"A": "actual shipped NormalCdf/native Mann–Whitney path", "B": "isolated final-tail expression using Math.NET Numerics5.0.0; unchanged native rank body and decision policy", "H": "independent mpmath100/200-digit normal probability with explicit nearest-even binary64 conversion", "S": "SciPy1.17.0 ordinary survival probability; separate logsf diagnostic", "control": "unchanged Kruskal–Wallis"}
ademp.performance: 3,173 scalars, eight specials and 165 native rank cases. Candidate has 170 scalar failures, 5/365 threshold-policy mismatches and zero rank failures; premature zeros fall from 2,108 to zero. Isolated primitive throughput median ratio is 4.454. Candidate NO-GO; numerical edge-case and cost contract, not a practical error-rate estimate.
ademp.truth: High-precision100/200-digit reference with explicit binary64 rounding; deterministic numerical truth.

ademp.aims: Measure corrected tau-b impact while requiring exact agreement with retained legacy diagnostics.
ademp.data: Same120 historical split recipes reconstructed; original full score vectors were not retained.
ademp.estimands: Rank association and winner agreement under repeated development splits, not detection power.
ademp.methods: Legacy unversioned arithmetic vs corrected kendall-tau-b-v2 on the same newly retained projected12-score vector pairs; original retained legacy diagnostics checked for exact agreement.
ademp.performance: 120/120 reconstructed recipes match all retained legacy diagnostics. Median tau changes from 0.714259874 to 0.720023041; winner agreement remains 27/120. Zero undefined, failed or missing cases. Supporting Round42 checks corrected tau-b arithmetic separately; replay does not recover original unretained vectors or provide independent scientific validation.
ademp.truth: No independent population truth for stability; exact legacy diagnostic matching is an engineering constraint.

ademp.aims: Compare existing component and observed-summary routes on the same repeated-measurement inputs.
ademp.data: 192datasets,32percondition;2groups×16entities×40repeats; Gaussian null/location/within/between/combined plus standardizedt5 equal-distribution stress.
ademp.estimands: H_W:sigma0²=sigma1² and H_B:tau0²=tau1² with nuisance freedom vs12summary rank hypotheses; different claims must stay distinct.
ademp.methods: {"analytic_references": {"between": {"adjustment": 2, "alternative_diagnostic_conditions": [3], "conditions": [0, 1, 3], "df_denominator": 15, "df_numerator": 15, "null_distribution_valid_conditions": [0, 1], "p": "same two-sided F formula", "statistic": "sample variance of G1 entity means / sample variance of G0 entity means", "stress_inapplicable": true, "unequal_within_conditions_unavailable": [2, 4]}, "source": "https://itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/eda/section3/eda359.htm", "within": {"Q": "sum within-entity squared residuals from raw observations", "adjustment": 2, "conditions": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "df_denominator": 624, "df_numerator": 624, "p": "min(1,2*min(scipy.stats.f.cdf(F,df1,df0),scipy.stats.f.sf(F,df1,df0)))", "statistic": "(Q1/624)/(Q0/624)"}}, "legacy": {"calibration_or_selection_included": false, "decision": "any finite shipped adjusted p <0.05", "fixed_family_size": 12, "individual_metric_diagnostics": "all12 fixed slots, no selected best metric", "label": "legacy12summaryBonf_observed_family", "not_full_deployed_pipeline": true, "production_metrics": true, "production_rank_test": "shipped two-group Mann-Whitney including ties and continuity arithmetic"}, "variance": {"alpha": 0.05, "between_effect": 2, "decision_family": 2, "full_reference_grid": 0.005, "full_reference_reject_max_exceedances": 3, "no_cache_replay": true, "reference_p": "(1+k)/(m+1), k=count(reference>=observed), m=finite reference count", "reference_replications": 199, "repetitions": 100, "strict_adjusted_p_lt_alpha": true, "within_effect": 2}}
ademp.performance: 192/192 paired datasets completed, 32 per condition and zero unavailable. Variance/legacy rejection numerators: C0 0/0, C1 2/32, C2 32/32, C3 15/1, C4 32/32, C5 t5 null 5/0; every denominator is 32. C3 paired difference 0.4375, conservative pointwise 95% interval [0.115361, 0.646603]. C5 variance Wilson 95% interval [0.068644, 0.317541]. Different hypothesis families, small development pilot, no overall winner.
ademp.truth: C0,C5 global null;C1 is component null but summary alternative;C2 within alternative/between null;C3 between alternative/within null;C4 both alternatives.
